name: poisoning-wbtc-68m-legit-counterparty
why: Verified live on 2026-09-30 ~20:00Z (use ctx.now = 2026-09-30T20:00:00Z). False-positive control. This is the REAL test tx that the victim sent to their legitimate counterparty (0xb18ab131...: 0.05 native ETH to 0xd9A1b0B1e1aE382DbDc898Ea68012FfcB2853a91, data 0x). The legitimate one has NO flags (GoPlus all '0'; Blockscout is_scam=false, reputation 'ok', EOA with no code) and the victim had already sent it real value (not a first interaction). It must NOT be red: a naive rule 'same prefix/suffix as another counterparty' would flag it red because there are two lookalikes in the history (0xd9A1C3... and 0xD9A192...). YELLOW is a design decision (not literal from spec §2): the destination is a genuine prior counterparty (tx.from = victim, real value, the first of the three to appear) but there are similar addresses in the history -> warn 'verify the full address'. With the literal spec it would be GREEN. eth_simulateV1 OK (traceTransfers emits a Transfer log from 0xeeee...eeee for 0.05 ETH). The rule 'asset outflow with nothing in return' must NOT apply to a simple send by the user themself (native transfer or ERC-20 transfer), or every send would be red.
